title: Lane W0: OMLX Comparative Architecture Audit for Rig Relay Runtime Substrate Decision
summary: Production-grade comparative architecture study of jundot/omlx (Apache 2.0, macOS/Apple Silicon local LLM inference server) against Rig Relay's current providers/local_inference/ governance stack. OMLX implements all 14 inspected capabilities with verified source code. Rig Relay implements zero inference engine capabilities — it is exclusively a governance/observability wrapper around external OpenAI-compatible endpoints. The two systems are complementary: OMLX serves inference; Rig Relay governs tool authorization, evidence issuance, repository mutation, and release transitions. This audit provides the capability matrix, license analysis, overlap classification, and authority boundary mapping required for the binding Runtime Substrate Decision.

external_substrate.primary_inference_backend: Apple MLX framework (mlx, mlx-lm, mlx-vlm, mlx-embeddings)
external_substrate.model_acquisition_method: Download from HuggingFace Hub or ModelScope on demand via built-in downloader

rig_relay_current_state.inference_engine: None. Rig Relay has no inference engine. All inference is delegated through an OpenAI-compatible HTTP client (execution_client.py) to external endpoints (Ollama, vLLM, llama.cpp server).
rig_relay_current_state.architecture_classification: Governance/observability wrapper, not a runtime engine.

licensing_assessment.application_code_license: Apache License 2.0 — verified from LICENSE file in repository.
apache_2_grants: Perpetual, worldwide, non-exclusive, no-charge, royalty-free, irrevocable copyright license
Right to reproduce, prepare derivative works, publicly display, publicly perform, sublicense, and distribute
Patent license from contributors (explicit grant section)
No trademark license (trademarks excluded by section 6)
apache_2_obligations: Must include copy of the license in any redistribution (section 4a)
Must include NOTICE file if present (section 4d)
Must state changes made to licensed files (section 4b)
Must retain copyright, patent, trademark, and attribution notices (section 4c)
licensing_assessment.redistribution_rights: Full rights to redistribute OMLX application code under Apache 2.0 compliance. This includes bundling in Rig Relay distributions (e.g., pyinstaller bundles) provided LICENSE and NOTICE are preserved and changes are documented.
licensing_assessment.adaptation_rights: Full rights to create derivative works, copy source, and adapt specific OMLX implementation components. Requires documentation of changes and preservation of original notices.
licensing_assessment.notice_obligations: If OMLX source is redistributed or adapted, the LICENSE file must be included and any existing NOTICE file preserved. Modified files must carry a prominent notice stating changes.
licensing_assessment.model_license_separation: CRITICAL: Apache 2.0 covers only OMLX's application code. It does NOT cover models downloaded from HuggingFace or ModelScope. Each downloaded model carries its own license (LLaMA Community License, Mistral Research License, DeepSeek License, etc.). Rig Relay must never imply that Apache-licensed OMLX code grants rights to redistribute or use downloaded model weights. Users are solely responsible for model license compliance.
licensing_assessment.third_party_dependency_implications: OMLX depends on mlx, mlx-lm, mlx-vlm, mlx-embeddings (MIT licensed, Apple), dflash-mlx (Apache 2.0), transformers (Apache 2.0), fastapi (MIT), uvicorn (BSD), huggingface-hub (Apache 2.0), Pillow (HPND), psutil (BSD), jsonschema (MIT). All are permissively licensed and compatible with Apache 2.0 redistribution. The mlx ecosystem is Apple Silicon exclusive.
licensing_assessment.bundling_feasibility: TECHNICALLY LEGAL under Apache 2.0 but OPERATIONALLY RISKY for v1: OMLX is ~200KB+ of server code with deep MLX framework coupling, macOS 15.0+ requirement, and pinned git-commit dependencies. Bundling would make Rig Relay's macOS app 300MB+ larger and create a maintenance surface for OMLX updates, MLX version compatibility, and model ecosystem management. NOT RECOMMENDED for v1.
licensing_assessment.key_risk: The Apache 2.0 license explicitly disclaims warranty and liability (sections 7-8). If OMLX crashes, produces incorrect model output, or causes kernel panics from GPU buffer exhaustion, OMLX contributors bear no liability. Rig Relay would need its own safety wrappers and failure recovery regardless of integration posture.
